creator: Alexander Terp
description: A hidden helper ran a bounded `claude -p` review. While it ran, `muster window --json` showed its session and resume command; after it exited, `pane restart` said it "has nothing to resume: its agent has reported no session", and the agent had to resume by hand from an id saved earlier. Keep the last resumable identity after a one-shot agent exits, or say why restart cannot use it. From tooling feedback a_30XLjRBB9.
title: A one-shot claude -p pane loses its session once the process exits, so pane restart cannot resume it
